summary: Rabbi Soffer discusses the concept of separation from unnecessary worldly indulgences as presented in the fourteenth chapter of Mesilat Yesharim. He explains how to train the mind to recognize the fleeting nature of physical desires and emphasizes the necessity of setting aside time for contemplation to maintain focus on Hashem. The class also addresses the importance of choosing appropriate social circles and taking gradual steps toward reducing overindulgence.
questions: How can I stop overindulging in things that are not necessary?
Why is it important to have time for contemplation during the day?
How do I know if my friends are a bad influence on my spiritual path?
What is the best way to make lasting changes in my behavior?
